name: stri_timezone_set
title: Set or Get Default Time Zone in stringi

origin.description: Changes the current default time zone for stringi date and time functions.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: A single time zone identifier. An empty string or an unknown identifier is an error.

origin.details: The new zone is the meaning of a NULL time zone argument. The previous identifier is returned invisibly. Restore it when the change should not leak.
origin.value: A string with the previously used time zone identifier.

translation.description: Sets the default time zone and returns the previous identifier.

arguments.name: tz
arguments.text: One ICU time zone identifier. An empty string, NA, or an unknown identifier is an error.

translation.details: The change is global in the process. The previous identifier is returned, not hidden. Put the call in try/finally and restore the previous zone.
translation.value: The previous zone identifier as a string.
translation.example:
from stringi.datetime import stri_timezone_set
previous = stri_timezone_set("Pacific/Auckland")
stri_timezone_set(previous)
print(f'stri_timezone_set("Pacific/Auckland") returns {previous}.')
